_about: Companies that use Preciops free, by arrangement. An entry with domains applies to any company whose owner has a confirmed email at one of those domains (whatever the company is called); without domains it matches the company name (punctuation, spacing, case and LLC/Inc. ignored). Applied when the owner confirms their email, at sign-up for name-only entries, and on every deploy (scripts/complimentary.mjs).
